project.title: Do early-stage teams need research memory?
project.question: Will small B2B startup teams repeatedly use a research-memory workspace to make better product decisions?

hypothesis.statement: If research evidence, assumptions, and decisions stay connected, early-stage teams will return to the workspace when making product decisions.
hypothesis.behavior_to_measure: Repeat validation sessions and evidence-linked decisions
hypothesis.falsifier: Teams complete one interview but do not return or link evidence to a decision

sources.title: Synthetic interview memo

sources.title: Synthetic methods note
sources.excerpt: A pre-trend check is informative but cannot validate every identifying assumption.

claims.text: The team changed its workflow after a visible coordination failure.
A repeat-use signal should be observed within two weeks of the first validation session.

decision.text: Run a two-week behavioral validation before treating the problem as a repeated need.
